openCompliance.detail: Reportable spill (>= 5 bbl) not reported within 24 hours of discovery.
Follow-up soil sampling found residual hydrocarbons; remediation verification still pending.

activeNotes.author: Emily Carter
activeNotes.text: Pump jack counterweights rebalanced. Expect slightly lower wellhead temperature (~3 C) from now on; this is normal.

activeNotes.author: Jake Morales
activeNotes.text: Well shut in from 7 Oct for planned rod string replacement. Work order not yet in the maintenance system. Expected back online around 20 Oct.

activeNotes.author: Ryan Brooks
activeNotes.text: Inspection INS-0101-0197: I think this was only produced water, not crude.

activeNotes.author: Chris Dalton
activeNotes.text: Inspection INS-0101-0197: sampled the stain, it is crude oil. The detection stands.
